requirement-traceability.title: Acceptance traceability
requirement-traceability.intro: Trace this requirement version from each criterion to its approved tasks, execution and acceptance.
requirement-traceability.invalid_read: Traceability could not be verified for this requirement. Refresh before following evidence links.
requirement-traceability.access_changed: Access changed. Protected facts are hidden; retry with current access.
requirement-traceability.version_changed: This requirement changed after the detail was opened. Refresh the detail before opening task or execution evidence.
requirement-traceability.eligibility.non: No published design maps the current criteria. Publish and adopt task proposals in Design and breakdown.
requirement-traceability.eligibility.cur: Mappings use the current requirement and published design.
requirement-traceability.eligibility.req: The requirement changed after publication. Current criteria have no approved mapping until the design is reviewed and published again.
requirement-traceability.eligibility.ret: The design is retired. Its previous mappings do not establish acceptance of the current criteria.
requirement-traceability.eligibility.sou: The approved source could not be confirmed. Current criteria are shown without inferred mappings.
requirement-traceability.no_criteria: This requirement has no acceptance criteria yet.
requirement-traceability.unmapped_hint: Add criterion coverage to the task proposals, then publish and adopt the design to track delivery here.
requirement-traceability.binding.not_ado: Proposal not adopted. No formal task is bound yet.
requirement-traceability.binding.current: The adopted task matches the current approved design.
requirement-traceability.binding.exclude: This task was excluded from the adopted scope.
requirement-traceability.binding.retired: The task's adopted design is retired.
requirement-traceability.binding.publica: The published design changed. Review and adopt the current proposal before accepting this task.
requirement-traceability.binding.require: The adopted requirement version changed. Review the current source before continuing.
requirement-traceability.binding.task_ch: The formal task differs from the adopted proposal. Review and adopt the current task basis.
requirement-traceability.binding.source_: The formal task or its approved binding could not be confirmed.
requirement-traceability.basis.not_dispa: No execution is bound to this task.
requirement-traceability.basis.current: Execution inputs match the current task basis.
requirement-traceability.basis.changed: The task basis changed. This historical execution does not prove current delivery.
requirement-traceability.basis.unknown: The execution basis could not be confirmed.
requirement-traceability.test_counts: {{total}} test nodes · {{passed}} succeeded · {{failed}} failed · {{pending}} pending or unknown
requirement-traceability.test_boundary: These are test nodes from this exact run. They do not measure test-case coverage or summarize all child workflows.
requirement-traceability.no_tests: No test nodes are recorded in this run. No test pass is inferred.
requirement-traceability.boundary: Accepted-task counts require current approved mappings and formal acceptance of every counted task. Execution success and test results remain separate facts; criterion numbers belong only to this requirement version.
